lith_class.label: Rock type
lith_class.note: finest map scale at the centroid; classes by keywords of lith and unit name

lith_score.label: Rock type, lunar relevance
lith_score.note: anorthosite/gabbro 1.0 (lunar highland crust, the south pole), basalt/mafic 0.9 (maria), other igneous 0.6, metamorphic 0.4, sedimentary 0.2, unconsolidated 0.1

lith_name.label: Map unit
lith_name.note: unit name and age of the chosen map unit

crater_km.label: Distance to the nearest impact structure rim
crater_km.source: Wikipedia, List of impact structures on Earth (after the Earth Impact Database, PASSC), revision 1385736404; Wikidata impact craters (Q55818)
crater_km.note: great-circle distance from the centroid to the centre minus the radius, at least 0

crater_diam_km.label: Its diameter
crater_diam_km.note: null where the list gives none

volcano_km.label: Distance to the nearest Holocene volcano
volcano_km.source: Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program, Volcanoes of the World v5, Holocene list (WFS)
volcano_km.licence: free use with citation (Smithsonian GVP terms)
volcano_km.note: great-circle distance from the centroid; 1214 volcanoes

sand_pct.label: Sand, 0-5 cm
sand_pct.note: median over up to 9 points of the patch; null on rock, ice and water (no prediction)

permafrost_pct.label: Permafrost area fraction
permafrost_pct.source: ESA CCI Permafrost (Obu et al.), PFR 2019, ESA Open Science Catalog Zarr
permafrost_pct.note: Northern Hemisphere grid; median over the patch points; null outside the grid

ground_ice.label: Ground ice content
ground_ice.source: Brown et al., Circum-Arctic Map of Permafrost and Ground-Ice Conditions (NSIDC GGD318)
ground_ice.note: not read: the download needs an Earthdata login; null everywhere
